main_text.p: scopi Ecclesiæ proclamarent, amplexatos fuisse, illique adhæsisse etiam ante literas Pontificias Ioannis, quibus illius pœnitentia admittebatur, & qua peracta vnio cum Ecclesia, & ante vllũ aliud Synodale decretum. Sed qui ita se gerunt schismatici sunt, excommunicati sunt, extra Ecclesiam sunt. Ergo Synodus ista a Schismaticis, & excommunicatis celebrata nulla est.

Probentur singula. Qui schismati cum Photio adhæserunt, a summis Pontificibus Nicolao, & Adriano in Synodis Romanis, & Octaua Generali vna cum ipso Photio condemnantur, & excommunicantur. Sed qui Synodo huic interfuere, partes Photij semper tutati sunt, & illi affixi, & vt ita dicam adcorporati ad extremum perdurarunt, nec ab vllo Pontifice absoluti Ecclesiæ vnquam reconciliati sunt, sed αὐτόνομοι Iudices facti, nulla eminentioris potestatis facultate sibi facta sententiam pronunciarunt: imo sese Romano Pontifici præponunt, tanquam qui viciniores, & a rebus actis minus absentes, ipso Pontifice vsu, & experientia promptiores cognitiones habuerunt. Procopius Archiepiscopus Cæsariensis Act. 2. Ἡ μὲν πολλάκις ἀπομνήμονας ... τῆς ἡμετέρας ... ὡς ... ἡμῶν ... Ἰωάννου ... τὸν Οἰκου-[?] [illegible, ~12 letters]

page.notes: The Greek sentence is printed in Greek letters but is partly overlaid by handwritten marks and a blotch in the lower half of the line; the middle words are not legible letter by letter and are marked with ellipses only where I could not read them, so treat the Greek as approximate. The catchword "μδυι-" is a fragment of the next word, likely the start of "Οἰκουμενικῆς" or similar; I have not been able to read it reliably. Handwritten marks (a pencil-like scribble near the foot and a stray blotch) are not printed and were left out. The page has no marginal notes. The first paragraph continues from the previous page (cont="true"). The ellipses in the Greek line are a transcription limit, not printed text.
